research_object: A controllable solid-state non-Abelian anyon / Majorana topological-qubit primitive.
verified_problem_frame: The question is not whether topology is mathematically useful; it is whether a physical platform can show a linked, falsifiable evidentiary chain from gapped topological phase to scalable protected logical operation.
design_invariants: Do not call a zero-bias peak, gap closing, or topological-gap protocol a proof of non-Abelian braiding.
Do not call a fusion or braid-like outcome a proof without predeclared trivial controls and nonlocality/readout checks.
Do not claim observed results: the downstream work is a proposed research design only.
Separate physical realization, protected logical operations, and universal quantum computation.
Treat material and device evidence as scoped to the studied platform, not as a general property of all Majorana candidates.
